rca of the issue: RESOLVED. Root cause was FastAPI matching routes in registration order; Phase 2's /inspections/{iid} was registered first and captured 'queue' as iid. Fix verified: (1) server.py lines 12832-12833 now register_transportation_experience_routes BEFORE line 12839-12840 register_transportation_phase2_routes; (2) /inspections/queue now resolves to the experience layer's literal route; (3) /inspections/{real_uuid} still resolves to Phase 2 because the experience layer has no /{iid} pattern, so non-'queue' values still flow to Phase 2; (4) test_36 statically asserts the ordering invariant via AST inspection of server.py so any reorder will fail CI. Empty-tenant compliance fix verified: returns int 0 on a fleet with no eligible entities (was 100).
